title: kb_pack prints a route and what the kb has and lacks
goal: rag.py pack, pack -q and kb_pack print, under every weak or none verdict and every good verdict that carries a check: line or lacking terms, a `route: split|web` line, a `kb has:` line (the parts or key words with a cited line) and a `kb lacks:` line (the parts or key words with none), computed without a model; a clean good pack (no check: line, nothing lacking) prints byte for byte what it printed before and no route line.

run: How do I run the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler on AWS EKS with spot instances?

notes: Operator answers: pack stays model-free, stdlib only; no new always-on tokens (the route and has/lacks lines print only on the flagged verdicts, never in server instructions); clean good unchanged. Route values: `web` for none, `split` for weak and for a flagged good; a clean good prints no route line (reader).
